note: rg exact-word case-insensitive gates search selected files before parsing. Files predating range were not excluded because sessions can resume later. Only user events within requested event timestamps are exported. Other role records and compactions do not become human evidence.
date_gap_caution: No candidate in a month means no exact-word gates user record was found in available rollouts, not proof the user said nothing about gates. Some historical sessions may not be present.
dedup_policy: Same source event IDs, or same original turn ID plus text in old no-ID snapshots, are collapsed only within the original session. Identical texts with different event IDs/turn IDs remain separate, including the two requests7seconds apart.
classification_policy: Known instruction/skill injection, internal goal continuations, Guardian transcript copies and subagent/programmatic assignments are exported but excluded from genuine-user evidence. A structured September task remains ambiguous. Worktree cwd alone never disqualifies a message.
live_file_growth_note: Active rollout files grew during this read-only investigation. Initial byte totals and later per-root inventory were observed at different moments.
counter_scope_note: parsed_message_records and same_item_id_duplicate_records include both user and assistant message records. Other gate-specific counters concern user-role records.

cli_history_unrepresented_explanation.17: Removal-checklist request appears in CLI history and later tool output, but no standalone original user event remains in available rollouts. Preserve history evidence.
cli_history_unrepresented_explanation.19: The /goal command is preserved by CLI history; rollout includes generated goal-state copies, not a standalone original slash-command user event. Preserve history evidence.

coverage_caution: Available rollouts are not a complete guarantee of historical utterances. Missing file creation dates do not establish no messages, because sessions resume and snapshots replay older messages. No exact-word May user gate message was found in this corpus.
wordcount_definition: wordcount counts total words in the exact message. gates_occurrences counts case-insensitive exact-word gates occurrences, including user-supplied quotations flagged in the record.
uncertainty_note: Classification retains excluded source records for audit. Zero additional confirmed inputs is not proof no unavailable historical utterances exist.
